readme:
# Veo 3.1 Fast Text to Video

Veo 3.1 Fast text-to-video, the faster, lower-cost Veo 3.1 tier. Write a scene and get back a 4, 6, or 8 second clip with native audio: dialogue, music, and sound effects generated alongside the picture.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 20,000 characters. |
| `duration` | 4 / 6 / 8 | 8 | Output length in seconds. |
| `resolution` | `720p` / `1080p` / `4k` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `16:9` / `9:16` | `16:9` | Output frame shape. |
| `generate_audio` | boolean | true | Native dialogue, music, and effects; turning it off lowers the rate. |
| `negative_prompt` | string | — | What to avoid. |
| `seed` | integer 0–4294967295 | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |

## Billing

You pay for output seconds, Google's list price. With audio: $0.10 at 720p, $0.12 at 1080p, $0.30 at 4k. Without audio: $0.08 / $0.10 / $0.25 respectively.

| Output | 720p | 1080p | 4k |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4s with audio | $0.40 | $0.48 | $1.20 |
| 6s with audio | $0.60 | $0.72 | $1.80 |
| 8s with audio (default) | $0.80 | $0.96 | $2.40 |
| 8s without audio | $0.64 | $0.80 | $2.00 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe subject, action, setting, camera, and light, then the sound.
- Put dialogue in quotes and name the speaker.
- Use `negative_prompt` for things to keep out of frame.

## Limits

- Clips are 4, 6, or 8 seconds; chain `video-extend` calls for longer shots.
- Use Veo 3.1 for the highest quality.

## Also on SandBase

Other Veo 3.1 Fast endpoints: `google/veo3.1/fast/image-to-video`, `google/veo3.1/fast/first-last-frame-to-video`, `google/veo3.1/fast/reference-to-video`, `google/veo3.1/fast/video-extend`, `google/veo3.1/text-to-video`, `google/veo3.1/lite/text-to-video`.
